text: "Better detection" isn't a target. Before any rule gets built, Renata fixes the actual numbers this project is held to.
4 hours to detect a high-severity identity alert. 8 hours to begin containment once it's confirmed.
Every analytics rule gets a written coverage statement -- what it catches, and exactly what it deliberately excludes.
One honest stress test: a legacy service account, exempt from MFA and tagged to reduce alert noise, has a rare real sign-in from an unexpected country. Do these targets actually hold for it?
Next: designing the Sentinel and Defender XDR architecture these targets have to be built against.
